meta.title: Everything green: licensed, Skilled Worker route, salary clear, sponsorship offered

payload.requisition_text:
Software Engineer — Scheduling Systems
Thornber Computing Ltd · Victoria, London

Thornber builds workforce-scheduling software for NHS trusts: safe staffing levels, skill-mix rules, audit trails that survive inspection. 70 trusts, 15 years, profitable throughout.

The role sits in the rules-engine team (Java 21, a well-tended codebase with 85% meaningful coverage). You would implement new rostering constraints with clinicians in the room.

We need 1-3 years of JVM experience and the patience to model rules written by committees.

£45,000, pension matched to 6%, 27 days holiday. We will sponsor a Skilled Worker visa for the successful applicant; our HR team handles the CoS process and has done so dozens of times. Two interviews, one week turnaround.

expected.determining_fact: Thornber Computing Ltd is an A-rated Skilled Worker sponsor, the posting commits to sponsorship, and £45,000 clears both thresholds — all four checks pass with evidence.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: We will sponsor a Skilled Worker visa for the successful applicant

design_notes: Anchor case for the SPONSORABLE class: no traps, every check individually evidenced. A solver that abstains here is over-abstaining and verdict_utility docks it 0.75 relative to the correct call.
